PDF tool for Mac

# Add page numbers to a PDF in any corner.

“Page 3 of 12” on a contract, chapter numbers on a thesis, exhibit labels on a legal bundle. Preview can’t do it; Sheaf does it in one drag.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** To add page numbers to a PDF on a Mac, drag it, pause and choose Number pages in Sheaf, pick a style like “Page 1 of 9” and a corner, and save. You can skip the first page and add the file name or date. Preview has no page-numbering feature.Updated 13 November 2026

**Stays on your Mac**No upload, works offline

**No account**Nothing to sign up for

**Originals untouched**Every result is a new file

**One-time purchase**No subscription

How it works

## Page numbers in three moves.

No app to open, no window to find. It happens where the file already is.

1. **Drag**

Start dragging the file from Finder, Mail, Photos or your desktop.

2. **Pause**

Hold still for a moment. Sheaf’s actions open in a circle around your cursor.

3. **Choose More › Number pages**

Pick the style and corner; skip the cover if you like.

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Preview (built in)

No page numbering in Preview.

- Free
- Can’t add page numbers
- Text boxes per page are the only workaround

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

### SheafFastest

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- “1”, “Page 1”, “Page 1 of 9” or Bates
- Any corner, header or footer
- Skip the cover page

## Styles

- **Page numbers**: 1, Page 1, or Page 1 of 9.
- **Header or footer text**: the file name, today’s date, or your own words like “Exhibit A”.
- **Bates numbers** for legal productions: a prefix and a running number across many PDFs, like ACME000001. See [Bates numbering on Mac](https://sheafai.app/bates-numbering-mac).

## Text stays text

Numbers are drawn onto the page, and the existing text and links keep working.

**Sheaf for Mac**

Every PDF tool, right where you drag the file.

- Works offline
- Originals never changed
- Undo any result
- One purchase, no subscription
[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

## Questions

Can Preview add page numbers to a PDF?

No. Preview has no page-numbering tool; you’d have to add a text box to every page.

Can I start numbering on page 2?

Yes. Choose Skip first page, so the cover stays clean.

Can I number several PDFs as one sequence?

Yes, with Bates numbering, which continues the count across files.

## Questions

Is there a free alternative to Adobe Acrobat on Mac?

Preview is free and built in for reading, signing and simple merges. Sheaf has a free 7-day trial, then a one-time purchase.

Can I compress a PDF on Mac without Acrobat?

Yes. Preview’s Reduce File Size filter or Sheaf’s Compress both work without Acrobat.

Does Sheaf edit PDF text like Acrobat?

No. Sheaf does whole-document jobs like compress, merge, sign, redact, OCR and convert; it doesn’t edit existing text.

title: "Bank Statement PDF to Excel on Mac, Checked Row by Row"

url: https://sheafai.app/bank-statement-pdf-to-excel-mac
---

# How to convert a bank statement PDF to Excel on a Mac

Copying a statement into a spreadsheet by hand is slow, and online converters upload your financial records. Here's how to do it on your Mac, with a check that every row is right.

**In short:** To convert a bank statement PDF to Excel on a Mac, drag the PDF onto Sheaf and choose Excel. Sheaf reads each transaction into date, details, debit, credit and balance columns, checks each row against the running balance, highlights any row that doesn't add up, and saves an .xlsx or CSV file. It works offline, with scanned and password-protected statements.

Updated 9 November 2026

## Steps

1. Start dragging the statement PDFs from Finder or Mail.
2. Pause, then choose Excel in the circle of actions.
3. Review the rows. Any row that doesn't add up to the running balance is highlighted; click it to see that line in the PDF.
4. Choose Save as Excel (or CSV). Several statements become one workbook, with an All statements sheet.

## Why the balance check matters

Every converter can misread a line, especially on scans. Sheaf checks that each debit or credit takes the previous balance to the next one. If a row doesn't add up, you see it before it reaches your books, side by side with that line of the PDF.

## Statement layouts Sheaf reads

| Layout | Example banks | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Separate withdrawal and deposit columns | HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis | Value date and cheque/reference columns kept |
| One signed amount column, dates without a year | Chase and other US banks | Year taken from the statement period, including December–January |
| Money out / Money in | Barclays, Lloyds, NatWest | £ amounts |
| Debit / Credit with CR balances | CommBank, Westpac, ANZ | “CR” and “DR” balances understood |
| Dr/Cr marker column, newest first | Many Indian and Middle Eastern banks | Opening balance read from B/F lines |
| Scanned statements | Any | Read on the Mac, then checked against the balance |

Bank names are examples of common layouts; Sheaf isn't affiliated with any bank.

## Locked statements

Many banks send statements locked with a password made from your name, date of birth or customer ID. Save those details once and Sheaf opens them for you. See [how to unlock a password-protected PDF](https://sheafai.app/unlock-password-protected-pdf-mac).

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Free 7-day trial · then one purchase, no subscription

## Questions

### Can I convert a bank statement PDF to Excel without uploading it?

Yes. Sheaf converts it on your Mac. Nothing is uploaded.

### Does it work with scanned bank statements?

Yes. Sheaf reads the scanned page on the Mac and checks each row against the balance, so misread rows are highlighted.

### Can I convert several statements into one spreadsheet?

Yes. Drag them together; Sheaf makes one sheet per statement and an All statements sheet.

### Can I get CSV instead of Excel?

Yes. Choose Save as CSV. Dates are saved as YYYY-MM-DD.

title: "How to Add Bates Numbers to PDFs on Mac (Without Acrobat)"
description: "Add Bates numbers across a whole production of PDFs on a Mac: prefix, start number, digits and position. Continues from your last production. Works offline."
url: https://sheafai.app/bates-numbering-mac
---

# How to add Bates numbers to PDFs on a Mac

Bates numbering gives every page in a production a unique number, like SMITH000001. Here's how to do it on a Mac without a subscription.

**In short:** To Bates-number PDFs on a Mac, select the files in order, drag them onto Sheaf and choose Number pages › Bates numbers. Set a prefix, start number and number of digits; Sheaf numbers every page across all the PDFs in one sequence, remembers where you stopped for that prefix, and keeps the text searchable.

Updated 9 November 2026

## Steps

1. Select the documents for the production in Finder, in order, and start dragging.
2. Pause, choose Number pages, then Bates numbers.
3. Set the prefix (for example your matter code), the start number and the digits; the preview shows the range across all pages.
4. Choose Number. Each PDF gets a numbered copy; the next production continues the sequence.

## Good practice

- Use a prefix per matter or producing party, like ACME.
- Run [redaction](https://sheafai.app/redact-pdf-mac) before numbering so page counts don't change afterwards.
- Keep the white label behind the number so it reads on dark scans.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Free 7-day trial · then one purchase, no subscription

## Questions

### Does Preview do Bates numbering?

No. Preview can't add page or Bates numbers.

### Can numbering continue from a previous production?

Yes. Sheaf remembers the next number for each prefix on that Mac.

### Can I put the number in a different corner?

Yes: bottom right, center or left, or top right.

# The best PDF apps for Mac in 2026, compared.

Eight ways to compress, merge, sign and convert PDFs on a Mac: what each costs, where your files go, and who each one is really for.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** For quick everyday jobs without uploading, Sheaf (one-time purchase) or Preview (free) are the simplest. For editing the text inside PDFs, Adobe Acrobat or PDF Expert. For free with AI, PDFgear. For Mac plus Windows and phone, UPDF. Smallpdf and iLovePDF work in a browser but upload your files.Updated 13 November 2026

At a glance

## Eight PDF apps for Mac, side by side.

We make Sheaf, so we’ve tried hard to be fair: facts about other apps come from their own websites, checked 13 November 2026, and linked below. Prices change; their sites have the final word.

| App | Price | Billing | Where files are processed | Mac app | Best for (our take) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sheaf | Free 7-day trial, then US$14.99 once (launch price to 31 Dec 2026, then US$24.99) | One-time | On your Mac | Mac App Store | Everyday jobs in one drag, without uploading |
| Apple Preview | Free, built into macOS | — | On your Mac | Built in | Reading, quick markup, simple merges and signatures |
| Adobe Acrobat | Standard US$14.99/mo, Pro US$19.99/mo (annual plan, billed monthly); month-to-month US$24.99 / US$29.99 ([Adobe](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/pricing.html)) | Subscription | Desktop app; Adobe also runs online tools | Yes | Editing PDF text, building forms, Adobe workflows |
| PDF Expert | Yearly plan or one-time Lifetime (Mac only); price shown in your currency ([Readdle](https://pdfexpert.com/pricing)) | Subscription or one-time | Desktop app | Mac App Store | Reading, annotating and editing on Mac |
| PDFgear | Free, “without signing up” ([PDFgear](https://www.pdfgear.com/)) | Free | Desktop app and web tools; AI features | Mac App Store | A free all-rounder, with AI chat |
| UPDF | Yearly plan or one-time Lifetime; free version adds watermarks to edited files ([UPDF](https://updf.com/pricing/)) | Subscription or one-time | Desktop app; AI features online | Yes (also Windows, iOS, Android) | One licence across Mac, Windows and phone |
| Smallpdf | Pro billed annually per user; 7-day free trial ([Smallpdf](https://smallpdf.com/)) | Subscription | In the browser (web platform) | No Mac app listed (Windows and mobile) | Quick jobs in a browser on any computer |
| iLovePDF | Free plan with per-task limits; Premium subscription ([iLovePDF](https://www.ilovepdf.com/pricing)) | Free or subscription | In the browser | Desktop app with Premium | Occasional jobs in a browser |

“Where files are processed” is what each company’s site says or shows. If a site doesn’t say whether its desktop app works offline, we haven’t guessed.

How to choose

## Pick by the job, not the brand.

[**Quick jobs, many times a day**

Compress, merge, sign, convert: Sheaf does them where you drag the file. Preview handles the basics for free.
](https://sheafai.app/compress-pdf-mac)[**Editing the words in a PDF**

Changing paragraphs or building fillable forms is Acrobat’s and PDF Expert’s home turf. Sheaf doesn’t edit existing text.
](https://sheafai.app/adobe-acrobat-alternative-mac)
**Free is the priority**

Preview is built in. PDFgear is free with more tools. Sheaf keeps 3 actions a day free after its trial.

**Mac, Windows and phone**

UPDF and Acrobat cover every platform with one account. Sheaf is Mac-only.

[**Private documents**

Contracts, IDs, statements: use an app that works on your Mac rather than uploading to a website.
](https://sheafai.app/redact-pdf-mac)
**No subscription**

Sheaf is one purchase. PDF Expert and UPDF also sell lifetime licences. Acrobat and Smallpdf are subscriptions.

## Sheaf

A menu bar app: start dragging a PDF, pause, and actions open around your cursor. Compress, merge, split, sign, redact, OCR, convert, page numbers, watermarks, PDF to Excel and more, each in about a second, all on the Mac. **Not for:** editing existing text, annotating while you read, Windows or iPhone.

## Apple Preview

Free and already installed. It reads PDFs well and can merge (via thumbnails), sign, fill forms, rotate, redact by hand and reduce file size with a filter that often blurs text. **Not for:** page numbers, watermarks, OCR you can save, Word conversion.

## Adobe Acrobat

The most complete PDF editor, with text editing, form building and e-signature workflows. It’s a subscription: Standard is US$14.99 a month on an annual plan, Pro US$19.99 (Adobe’s US prices). **Overkill if** you mainly compress, merge and sign.

## PDF Expert

A polished Mac reader and editor from Readdle, sold as a yearly plan or a one-time Lifetime licence for Mac, on the Mac App Store. Strong for reading, annotating and editing.

## PDFgear

Free, with a long tool list and AI features (“PDFgear AI”), for Mac and the web. Its site doesn’t say which features run on your Mac and which online.

## UPDF

An editor for Mac, Windows, iOS and Android under one account, with yearly or lifetime licences. The free version adds trial watermarks to edited, annotated or protected files; AI features are an extra subscription.

## Smallpdf and iLovePDF

Popular browser tools: nothing to install, so they’re handy on a borrowed computer. You upload the file to their servers, and free use is limited. Smallpdf is billed annually per user; iLovePDF has a free plan with per-task limits and a Premium plan that adds a desktop app.

## Questions

What is the best free PDF app for Mac?

Preview, built into macOS, covers reading, signing, simple merges and form filling. PDFgear is free with more tools. Sheaf’s trial is free for 7 days, then 3 actions a day stay free.

What is the best Adobe Acrobat alternative for Mac?

It depends on the job: PDF Expert or UPDF for editing, Sheaf for fast everyday tasks without a subscription, Preview for the basics for free.

Which PDF apps work offline on Mac?

Preview and Sheaf run on your Mac. Smallpdf and iLovePDF’s web tools need the internet and upload files. Check other apps’ sites for which features need a connection.

Is there a PDF app for Mac without a subscription?

Yes: Sheaf is a one-time purchase, Preview and PDFgear are free, and PDF Expert and UPDF sell lifetime licences.

# Sheaf for Business

The PDF work legal, finance and HR teams do every day, right where they drag the file. Nothing is uploaded, so there is nothing to approve with your security team except the app.

## What your team gets

**Bates numbering**One sequence across every PDF in a production, like ACME000001. Continues from your last production with the same prefix.

**Page numbers, headers and footers**“Page 1 of 9”, file name, date, in any corner. Skip the cover page. Text and links keep working.

**Watermarks**Confidential, Draft or your own words, drawn into every page so they print and can’t be clicked away.

**Remove hidden data**Shows and removes author and edit history, comments, attached files, scripts and hidden layers. Pages look the same.

**Court-ready PDF**Flattens, removes hidden data, makes scans searchable and keeps each file under the e-filing limit, in parts if needed.

**Real redaction**Finds names, emails, phone, card, account and ID numbers, and deletes the text underneath.

**Fill and lock forms**Type into a PDF form, then save a copy with the answers locked into the page.

**PDF to Excel**Bank statements become a spreadsheet with every row checked against the running balance. Other tables become one sheet each.

**Unlock client statements**Opens password-protected statements, payslips and tax forms using client details kept in the Mac’s keychain.

**Certified true copies**Signature, name, membership number and date in one stamp, in each country’s wording. UDIN for Indian CAs.

**Upload size presets**Fit 10 MB for IRS and USCIS, 5 MB for India’s Income Tax and GST portals or Australia’s ATO and myGov.

**Shortcuts and folder automations**Every action works in Shortcuts, and a watched folder can number, clean or prepare files on its own.

## Why security teams say yes

- **Files never leave the Mac.** Every action runs on the device. Sheaf has no servers, no account and no analytics.
- **Sandboxed by Apple.** Sheaf ships only through the Mac App Store, signed and reviewed by Apple, and can open only the files a person drops or picks.
- **Originals are never changed.** Every result is a new file, with Undo.
- **One network use, and it’s optional.** When converting a web page file (HTML) to PDF, macOS may load the images that page links to. No other action touches the network.

## Managed settings

Send a configuration profile with the payload type com.vikashsingh.sheaf.business (or com.vikashsingh.sheaf for the regular app) from Jamf, Kandji, Intune, Mosyle or any MDM. A setting you set is locked in Sheaf’s Settings, and Settings shows “Managed by” your organization.

| Key | Type | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OrganizationName | String | Shown in Settings as “Managed by …”. |
| HiddenActions | Array of strings | Actions to remove, e.g. protect, sign. IDs: merge, compress, split, rotate, searchable, organize, sign, redact, protect, makePDF, toPDF, export, convertImage, resizeImage, number, watermark, clean, filing, fillForm, excel, unlock, certify. |
| outputMode | String | beside (next to the original) or folder. |
| outputFolderPath | String | Folder for results when outputMode is folder. |
| stripMetadata | Boolean | Remove author and document info from every result. |
| defaultCompression | String | high, balanced or small. |
| emailLimitMB | Integer | Size for “split into email-sized parts”. Default 25. |
| FilingLimitMB | Integer | Size limit for Court-ready PDFs. Default 35. |
| PortalLimitKB | Integer | Size for Compress › Fit upload presets, in KB. Default follows the country: 10000 in the US, 5000 elsewhere. |
| Country | String | Two-letter code (US, GB, IN, AU, CA, NZ, SG, ZA, AE) for certification wording, ID labels and upload size. Default: the Mac’s region. |
| DefaultWatermarkText | String | Words for the one-tap watermark, e.g. Privileged & Confidential. |
| BatesPrefix | String | Default Bates prefix, e.g. your matter code. |
| DisableReviewPrompts | Boolean | Never ask for an App Store rating. |
| DisableWatchedFolders | Boolean | Turn off folder automations. |

[Download a sample configuration profile](https://sheafai.app/sheaf-managed.mobileconfig) and edit the values before you upload it to your MDM.

## Questions

### Does Sheaf send any document data anywhere?

No. Every action runs on the Mac. Sheaf has no servers and collects no data.

### Why is there a separate business app?

Apple’s volume purchasing doesn’t support in-app purchases, so the regular Sheaf can’t be unlocked for a whole team. Sheaf for Business is paid once per Mac with everything included.

### Is the Bates sequence shared between people?

Each Mac remembers its own next number per prefix. For a shared production, give each person their own prefix or set the start number when numbering.

### Does removing hidden data change how pages look?

No. Pages look the same; author info, edit history, comments, attachments, scripts and hidden layers are removed.


---
title: "Certified True Copy Wording by Country (UK, AU, US, India)"
description: "Certified true copy wording for the UK, Australia, the US, Canada and India, who may certify, and how to stamp a PDF with signature and UDIN."
url: https://sheafai.app/certified-true-copy-pdf
---

# Certified true copy: wording by country, and how to stamp a PDF

A certified copy is a copy that someone qualified has compared with the original and signed. The wording and who may sign depend on the country, and on who will receive it.

**In short:** A certified true copy is usually marked with a sentence such as “I certify that this is a true copy of the original document seen by me”, plus the certifier's signature, name, occupation or qualification, registration number, contact details and the date. Australia expects “…sighted by me” on every page; Indian chartered accountants add a UDIN. On a Mac, Sheaf's Certify action stamps a PDF with this wording, your saved signature and details.

Updated 9 November 2026

## Usual wording and certifiers

| Country | Usual wording | Who usually certifies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| United Kingdom | “I certify that this is a true copy of the original document seen by me.” | Solicitor, accountant or other professional; signed, dated, with name, occupation and contact details |
| Australia | “I certify that this is a true and correct copy of the original document sighted by me.” | Authorised certifier, such as a CPA Australia or CA ANZ member; each page certified |
| New Zealand | “I certify that this is a true copy of the original document sighted by me.” | Justice of the Peace, lawyer or chartered accountant |
| United States | “I certify that this is a true, accurate and complete copy of the original document.” | Rules vary by state; a notary's copy certification needs their own seal and certificate |
| Canada | “I certify that this is a true copy of the original document, which I have seen.” | Usually a lawyer or notary; commissioners only in some provinces |
| India | “Certified True Copy” with signature, name, membership number and UDIN | Chartered accountant (UDIN from udin.icai.org), gazetted officer or notary |
| South Africa | “Certified a true copy of the original” | Commissioner of Oaths, on every page, with full name, designation and address |

Recipients can set their own rules; check what they accept before certifying.

## Stamp a certified copy on a Mac

1. Drag the copy, pause and choose Certify.
2. Pick your country under Wording; Sheaf fills in the usual sentence.
3. Add your name, role, firm and membership number (and UDIN in India). Your saved signature goes in automatically.
4. Choose every page, the first or the last, check the preview and certify.

For Indian chartered accountants, Sheaf checks that the UDIN has 18 characters and contains your membership number before it stamps.

## Sources

- [GOV.UK: Certifying a document](https://www.gov.uk/certifying-a-document)
- [OakNorth: certifying documents](https://oaknorth.co.uk/certifying-documents)
- [Bankwest: document certification guide](https://Bankwest.com.au/content/dam/bankwest/documents/help/customer-document-certification-guide.pdf)
- [WA Government: certified copies](https://www.wa.gov.au/system/files/2023-07/fact-sheet-certified-copies.pdf)
- [National Notary Association: copy certification](https://www.nationalnotary.org/notary-bulletin/blog/2015/10/important-facts-notaries-copy-certification)
- [Mondaq: commissioning vs notarizing in Canada](https://www.mondaq.com/canada/trials-amp-appeals-amp-compensation/172206/faqs-commissioning-vs-notarizing-a-document)

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Free 7-day trial · then one purchase, no subscription

## Questions

### What should a certified true copy say?

Commonly “I certify that this is a true copy of the original document seen by me”, followed by the certifier's signature, name, occupation, registration number, contact details and date.

### Can an accountant certify a copy?

In the UK, Australia, New Zealand and India, accountants who are members of a professional body are commonly accepted. Check with the recipient.

### What is a UDIN?

A Unique Document Identification Number that Indian chartered accountants generate on udin.icai.org for each certificate. It has 18 characters and includes the membership number.

Guide

# PDF too big to email? Fix it in one drag.

Gmail allows 25 MB of attachments per message, and many work mail servers allow less. Here’s how to get any PDF under the limit without uploading it anywhere.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** To email a PDF that’s too big, compress it with Sheaf’s Fit 25 MB (or the limit your email uses). If it can’t get that small without hurting quality, choose Split › By size to make parts that each fit, and send them in separate emails.Updated 13 November 2026

**Stays on your Mac**No upload, works offline

**No account**Nothing to sign up for

How it works

## PDF too big to email in three moves.

No app to open, no window to find. It happens where the file already is.

1. **Drag**

Start dragging the file from Finder, Mail, Photos or your desktop.

2. **Pause**

Hold still for a moment. Sheaf’s actions open in a circle around your cursor.

3. **Choose Compress › Fit 25 MB**

Sheaf shrinks it until it fits. Still too big? Split › By size makes parts that fit.

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Preview (built in)

Export with Quartz Filter › Reduce File Size, then check the size.

- Free
- No target size: try and check
- Text often comes out blurry

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

### SheafFastest

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- Targets a size: Fit 25 MB or Fit 5 MB
- Splits into parts that each fit
- Text stays sharp

## How big is too big?

Personal Gmail accounts can attach up to 25 MB per message; anything larger is turned into a Google Drive link ([Google’s help page](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6584)). Other providers and company mail servers set their own limits, and many are lower, so check yours.

Attachments grow by about a third when they’re encoded for email, and the whole message counts, so aim a little under the limit.

## Why not use a cloud link?

Links work, but the receiver needs to open another site, links expire, and some offices block them. A file under the limit just arrives.

## Uploading to a portal instead?

Government and job portals often allow far less, sometimes 2–10 MB. See [PDF size limits for IRS, USCIS, ATO and other portals](https://sheafai.app/pdf-size-limits-government-portals), and use Fit 5 MB.

- Undo any result

## Questions

How do I reduce a PDF to under 25 MB on a Mac?

Drag it, pause, choose Compress › Fit 25 MB in Sheaf. In Preview, Export with the Reduce File Size filter and check the result.

What if the PDF is still too big after compressing?

Split it into email-sized parts with Split › By size and send them in separate emails, or share a link instead.

Why is my PDF so large?

Usually scanned pages or photos saved at full resolution. Compressing shrinks those images and keeps text sharp.

PDF tool for Mac

# Compress a PDF on Mac in one second.

Email limits are usually 20–25 MB and scanned PDFs blow past that fast. Shrink any PDF right where it is, without sending it to a website.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** To compress a PDF on a Mac, drag it, pause, and choose Compress in Sheaf: the smaller copy appears next to the original, with text kept sharp. Preview’s Reduce File Size filter also works, but often blurs text.Updated 13 November 2026

**Stays on your Mac**No upload, works offline

**No account**Nothing to sign up for

**Originals untouched**Every result is a new file

**One-time purchase**No subscription

How it works

## Compress PDF in three moves.

No app to open, no window to find. It happens where the file already is.

1. **Drag**

Start dragging the file from Finder, Mail, Photos or your desktop.

2. **Pause**

Hold still for a moment. Sheaf’s actions open in a circle around your cursor.

3. **Let go on Compress**

The smaller copy appears beside the original, with the result, like “42.7 MB → 3.3 MB”.

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Preview (built in)

File › Export, Quartz Filter › Reduce File Size.

- Free and already on your Mac
- One setting; text and charts often go blurry
- Sometimes makes small files bigger

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

### SheafFastest

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- About a second, even for big scans
- Text stays sharp; images and scans shrink most
- Fit 25 MB for email, Fit 5 MB for upload forms

## What actually makes a PDF big

Almost always it’s images: scanned pages, photos and slide backgrounds saved at full camera resolution. Text and vector drawings are tiny by comparison. A good compressor shrinks the images and leaves the text alone, so the file gets smaller while the words stay crisp when you zoom in or print.

That’s the difference you see between Preview’s Reduce File Size filter and Sheaf. Preview applies one aggressive setting to everything, which is why text in scans and charts often turns soft. Sheaf compresses scans and photos hardest and keeps text as text.

## Choosing a size

- **Balanced** (default) is made for email: most files drop 70–90% and still look right on screen and on paper.
- **Fit 25 MB** keeps going until the file fits the usual email limit; **Fit 5 MB** targets upload forms.
- If a file can’t get small enough without hurting it, [split it into email-sized parts](https://sheafai.app/split-pdf-mac) instead.

## Real numbers

On a Mac with Apple silicon, a 42.7 MB slide deck becomes 3.3 MB in about 0.6 seconds (Balanced). Your results depend on what’s inside the PDF: a scan of 30 pages shrinks far more than a text-only report that’s already small.

## Why not use a website?

Online compressors work, but the file is uploaded to someone else’s server. That’s a bad trade for contracts, IDs, tax returns, medical records and bank statements, which are exactly the files that tend to be large scans. Sheaf never uploads anything; it works with Wi-Fi off.

**Sheaf for Mac**

Every PDF tool, right where you drag the file.

- Works offline
- Originals never changed
- Undo any result
- One purchase, no subscription
[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

## Questions

Does compressing a PDF reduce quality?

Some, mostly in images. Sheaf’s Balanced setting shrinks scans and photos while keeping text as sharp vector text, so documents still read and print well.

How do I compress a PDF on a Mac for free?

Preview can: File › Export, then Quartz Filter › Reduce File Size. It’s free but often blurs text. Sheaf’s 7-day trial is free and then keeps 3 actions a day free.

Is it safe to compress PDFs online?

Online tools upload your document to their servers. For private documents, use an app that compresses on your Mac, like Preview or Sheaf.

How do I make a PDF small enough to email?

Compress it with Fit 25 MB. If it still doesn’t fit, split it into email-sized parts. Sheaf does both from the same drag.

# Everything Sheaf does

Sheaf is a Mac app for PDF work. Start dragging a file, pause, and the actions appear around your cursor. Every action runs on your Mac: files aren't uploaded, there's no account, and the original is never changed.

**In short:** Sheaf is a PDF app for macOS 14 or later that compresses, merges, splits, signs, redacts, converts and OCRs PDFs, turns bank statements into Excel, unlocks password-protected statements, adds Bates numbers and stamps certified true copies. It works offline and keeps files on the Mac. It has a free 7-day trial, then a one-time purchase.

Updated 9 November 2026

## Everyday PDF tools

**Compress**Shrinks scans and images, keeps text sharp. Fit 25 MB makes a file small enough to email; Fit 5 MB meets upload forms.

**Merge**PDFs and images into one PDF, in Finder order, with a bookmark for each file.

**Split**By page, by page range, or into email-sized parts.

**Organize**Reorder, rotate and delete pages across several PDFs, then save one clean file.

**Make searchable (OCR)**Turns scanned pages into text you can search, select and copy, on the Mac.

**Rotate & straighten**Turns sideways pages upright and straightens crooked scans.

**Sign**Draw your signature once and place it on any page. Kept only on your Mac.

**Redact**Finds names, emails, phone, card, account and ID numbers, and deletes the text underneath.

**Protect**Adds a password that's needed to open the PDF.

**Convert**Word, text and web files to PDF; PDF to JPEG, PNG, Word or text; images to JPEG, PNG, HEIC or AVIF.

## For professional work

**PDF to Excel**Bank and card statements become a spreadsheet, every row checked against the running balance. Other tables become one sheet each.

**Unlock with client details**Opens password-protected statements, payslips and tax forms using the details you saved for each client.

**Certified true copy**A stamp with your signature, name, membership number and date, in the wording your country uses. UDIN for Indian CAs.

**Bates numbering**One sequence across every PDF in a production, like ACME000001, continuing from your last production.

**Page numbers, headers & footers**“Page 1 of 9”, file name or date in any corner. Skip the cover page.

**Watermark**Confidential, Draft or your own words, drawn into every page.

**Remove hidden data**Author, edit history, comments, attachments, scripts and hidden layers. Pages look the same.

**Court-ready**Flattened, searchable, hidden data removed, and under the e-filing size limit, split into parts if needed.

**Fill forms**Type into a PDF form, then save it or lock the answers into the page.

**Upload size presets**One tap to fit a portal's limit: 10 MB for IRS and USCIS, 5 MB for India's Income Tax and GST portals or Australia's ATO and myGov.

## Automation and IT

**Shortcuts**Use Sheaf's actions in the Shortcuts app, including “Convert a bank statement to Excel”.

**Watched folders**Drop files in a folder and Sheaf compresses, numbers or cleans them on its own.

**Managed settings**IT can set defaults, hide actions and lock settings with any MDM. Deploy through Apple Business Manager.

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

- Free and built in
- Works on several files

- JPEG, PNG, HEIC or AVIF
- Resize in the same step (2560, 1600, 1080 px)
- Works on photos dragged from Photos

## Why HEIC causes trouble

HEIC files are about half the size of JPEGs at the same quality, which is why iPhones use them. But many upload forms, older Windows PCs and some websites only accept JPEG or PNG. Converting before you upload avoids “unsupported file” errors.

## Need them smaller too?

Choose **Resize** to make the long side 2560, 1600 or 1080 pixels: ideal for email and web forms. Or turn the photos into one PDF with [Make PDF](https://sheafai.app/jpg-to-pdf-mac).

How do I convert HEIC to JPG on a Mac for free?

Right-click the photos in Finder › Quick Actions › Convert Image, or open one in Preview and export as JPEG.

Can I convert many HEIC files at once?

Yes. Select them all, drag, and choose Convert › JPEG in Sheaf.

Does converting lose quality?

Slightly, as JPEG is compressed; at normal settings the difference isn’t visible.

PDF tool for Mac

# Make scanned PDFs searchable.

A scan is just a picture of text: you can’t search it, copy from it or highlight it. OCR adds the text, so you can.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** To OCR a PDF on a Mac, drag the scan, pause and choose Make searchable in Sheaf. It reads every page with macOS’s on-device text recognition and saves a copy you can search and copy from, looking exactly the same. Preview’s Live Text lets you select text but doesn’t save a searchable PDF.Updated 13 November 2026

**Stays on your Mac**No upload, works offline

**No account**Nothing to sign up for

**Originals untouched**Every result is a new file

**One-time purchase**No subscription

How it works

## OCR a scanned PDF in three moves.

No app to open, no window to find. It happens where the file already is.

1. **Drag**

Start dragging the file from Finder, Mail, Photos or your desktop.

2. **Pause**

Hold still for a moment. Sheaf’s actions open in a circle around your cursor.

3. **Let go on Make searchable**

A searchable copy appears. Pages look the same; now Cmd-F works.

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Preview (built in)

Live Text lets you select text in a scan.

- Free and built in
- Doesn’t save a searchable PDF
- Spotlight still can’t find the words

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

### SheafFastest

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- Searchable, copyable text on every page
- Runs on your Mac, no upload
- Pages look exactly the same

## What OCR gives you

- **Search** with Cmd-F in Preview, and find the file with Spotlight by words inside it.
- **Copy** a paragraph or a number out of a scanned contract or statement.
- **Highlight** and annotate text in scanned course readers.

## Why on-device matters

Scans are often the most private documents you have: IDs, medical letters, signed contracts. Sheaf uses the text recognition built into macOS, so nothing leaves your Mac.

## Fix the scan first

Crooked or sideways pages recognise better when they’re upright: use [Straighten](https://sheafai.app/rotate-pdf-mac) first. Big scans also shrink a lot with [Compress](https://sheafai.app/compress-pdf-mac).

**Sheaf for Mac**

Every PDF tool, right where you drag the file.

- Works offline
- Originals never changed
- Undo any result
- One purchase, no subscription
[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

## Questions

Does Mac have built-in OCR for PDFs?

macOS has Live Text, which lets you select text in images and scans in Preview, but it doesn’t save a searchable PDF. Sheaf uses the same on-device recognition to save one.

Will OCR change how my PDF looks?

No. The text is added invisibly behind each page image, so the page looks the same.

Which languages does OCR support?

Sheaf uses macOS’s text recognition, which reads many languages, including English, major European languages, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, depending on your macOS version.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** To password-protect a PDF on a Mac, drag it, pause and choose Protect in Sheaf, then type a password. Sheaf saves an encrypted copy that asks for the password to open. Preview can also encrypt when you export a PDF.Updated 13 November 2026

**Stays on your Mac**No upload, works offline

**No account**Nothing to sign up for

**Originals untouched**Every result is a new file

**One-time purchase**No subscription

How it works

## Password-protect PDF in three moves.

No app to open, no window to find. It happens where the file already is.

1. **Drag**

Start dragging the file from Finder, Mail, Photos or your desktop.

2. **Pause**

Hold still for a moment. Sheaf’s actions open in a circle around your cursor.

3. **Choose More › Protect**

Type a password. An encrypted copy appears next to the original.

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Preview (built in)

File › Export, tick Encrypt, type a password.

- Free and built in
- Encrypts the PDF
- Easy to overwrite the original

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

### SheafFastest

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- Encrypted copy, original untouched
- Asks for the password to open
- Nothing uploaded

## Send the password separately

A password is only as safe as how you share it. Send the PDF by email and the password by text message or a call, never in the same email.

## Good passwords for documents

Use something the receiver can type easily but others can’t guess: three random words beat a short complicated one. Banks and payroll often use a date of birth or part of an ID number; that’s convenient but weaker.

## Opening protected PDFs you receive

Got a statement or payslip locked with your details? See [how to open a password-protected PDF](https://sheafai.app/unlock-password-protected-pdf-mac).

How do I put a password on a PDF on a Mac for free?

Can I remove the password later?

If you know it, yes: open the protected copy and save it without encryption, or keep the original you started from.

Is a password-protected PDF secure?

Modern PDF encryption is strong; the weak point is usually the password. Use a long one and send it separately.

---
title: "PDF Size Limits: IRS, USCIS, ATO, Income Tax & GST Portals"
description: "File size limits for government upload portals in the US, Australia, India, Canada and the UK, and how to compress a PDF under the limit on a Mac."
url: https://sheafai.app/pdf-size-limits-government-portals
---

# PDF size limits for government upload portals

Tax and immigration portals reject files over their limit, often after you've filled in the whole form. Here are the limits for the most-used portals, and how to get under them.

**In short:** Common per-file limits are 15 MB for the IRS Documentation Upload Tool, 12 MB for USCIS, 6 MB for the ATO's online services, 5 MB for India's Income Tax and GST portals and 5 MB for myGov Child Support. To get a PDF under a limit on a Mac, drag it onto Sheaf and choose Compress › Fit, which compresses until the file is under the size and keeps text sharp.

Updated 9 November 2026

## Limits by portal

| Country | Portal | Limit | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| United States | IRS Documentation Upload Tool | 15 MB per file | [IRS](https://www.irs.gov/node/119146) |
| United States | USCIS online filing | 12 MB per file | USCIS filing tips |
| United States | Federal court e-filing (CM/ECF) | Set by each court; often 35–50 MB | Court websites |
| Australia | ATO online services (business and agents) | 6 MB per file, 6 files per message | [ATO](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/reportable-tax-position-schedule-2023-instructions/other-information) |
| Australia | myGov: Centrelink | 10 MB per upload, up to 10 files | [Services Australia](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/upload-your-centrelink-documents-online) |
| Australia | myGov: Child Support | 5 MB per file | Services Australia |
| India | Income Tax e-proceedings | 5 MB per file | Income Tax portal |
| India | GST portal (refunds, notices) | 5 MB per file; some registration proofs 500 KB | GST portal |
| Canada | CRA: Submit documents | 500 MB per submission | [CRA](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/e-services/submit-documents-online.html) |
| United Kingdom | HMRC and visa services | Varies by service | Shown on each service's upload page |

Checked 9 November 2026. Portals change their limits; the upload page always has the final word.

## Get a PDF under the limit

1. Start dragging the PDFs, pause and choose Compress.
2. Choose Fit with your portal's size, for example Fit 5 MB.
3. Sheaf compresses each file until it's under the limit and keeps text sharp. Upload the copies, marked “upload”.

Sheaf sets the default size from your country: 10 MB in the US, 5 MB in India and Australia. Change it in Settings › Upload limit.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Free 7-day trial · then one purchase, no subscription

## Questions

### What is the IRS upload file size limit?

The IRS Documentation Upload Tool accepts JPEG, PNG and PDF files up to 15 MB each.

### What is the USCIS file size limit?

USCIS online filing accepts files up to 12 MB each for most forms. Check the form's upload page.

### What is the ATO attachment size limit?

ATO online services for business and agents accept up to 6 attachments per message, each up to 6 MB.

### How do I reduce a PDF to 5 MB on a Mac?

Drag it onto Sheaf and choose Compress › Fit 5 MB. If it can't get that small without hurting quality, Split makes parts under the limit.

# PDF software for accountants and finance teams

Client statements arrive as locked PDFs, portals reject big files, and certified copies need stamping. Sheaf handles all of it on your Mac, without sending client data to a website.

**In short:** Sheaf turns bank and card statement PDFs into Excel with every row checked against the running balance, opens password-protected statements using each client's saved details, stamps certified true copies (with UDIN for Indian chartered accountants) and shrinks files to a tax portal's upload limit. It works for CPAs, chartered accountants, bookkeepers and finance teams, entirely on the Mac.

Updated 9 November 2026

## What it does for you

**Bank statements to Excel**Every transaction in its own row with date, details, debit, credit and balance. Rows that don't add up to the balance are highlighted, so nothing slips into the books unchecked.

**Any bank, any country**Reads Indian, US, UK and Australian layouts: Dr/Cr columns, a single signed amount, money in and out, dates without a year, newest first, and scanned statements.

**Unlock client statements**Save each client's ID number, date of birth and customer IDs once. Sheaf opens their locked statements, India's AIS and Form 26AS, and UK payslips on its own.

**Certified true copy**Your signature, name, membership number and date in one stamp, in your country's wording. For Indian CAs, the UDIN is checked against your membership number.

**Fit the portal**One tap keeps each file under the limit: 10 MB for IRS and USCIS uploads, 5 MB for India's Income Tax and GST portals or Australia's ATO and myGov.

**Audit and working papers**Merge evidence into one PDF with bookmarks, add page numbers, watermark drafts and remove hidden data before sending.

**Redact before sharing**Remove account, card and tax ID numbers from documents you pass to third parties.

**Shortcuts**“Convert a bank statement to Excel” works in the Shortcuts app for batch jobs.

## A typical day

1. Drag a month of client statements onto Sheaf and choose Excel.
2. Locked ones open with the client's saved details; anything else asks once.
3. Check the highlighted rows against the PDF, shown side by side, then save one workbook with a sheet per statement and an All statements sheet.
4. Drag the signed financial statements and choose Certify, then Compress › Fit for the portal.

## Why it's safe to use with client files

- **Nothing is uploaded.** Every action runs on the Mac; Sheaf has no servers and no account.
- **Originals are never changed.** Each result is a new file next to the original, with Undo.
- **Sandboxed and reviewed by Apple.** Sheaf is sold only on the Mac App Store and opens only the files you give it.
- **Ready for IT.** [Sheaf for Business](https://sheafai.app/business) deploys through Apple Business Manager with managed settings.

See [every feature](https://sheafai.app/features).

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Free 7-day trial · then one purchase, no subscription

## Questions

### Can Sheaf convert a scanned bank statement to Excel?

Yes. Sheaf reads scanned pages on the Mac and then checks each row against the balance, so reading mistakes show up as highlighted rows.

### How does Sheaf know the Excel is right?

For statements with a running balance, Sheaf checks that each row's debit or credit takes the previous balance to the next one. Rows that don't add up are highlighted in the app and in Excel.

### Does Sheaf guess passwords?

No. It only tries passwords built from details you enter for your own clients, in the patterns banks and tax offices use, plus passwords you've saved. Those details are kept in this Mac's keychain.

### Can I add a UDIN to a certificate?

Yes. Choose India as the wording and paste the UDIN from udin.icai.org; Sheaf checks its length and that it contains your membership number.

It removes it. The text under each redaction is deleted from the new file, so it can't be copied or recovered from that file.

## PDF to JPG in three moves.

No app to open, no window to find. It happens where the file already is.

1. **Drag**

Start dragging the file from Finder, Mail, Photos or your desktop.

2. **Pause**

Hold still for a moment. Sheaf’s actions open in a circle around your cursor.

3. **Choose Convert › JPEG or PNG**

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Preview (built in)

File › Export, Format › JPEG, one page at a time.

- Free and built in
- One page per export
- Easy to lose track on long files

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

### SheafFastest

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- All pages in one step
- JPEG for photos, PNG for crisp text
- Named in page order

## JPEG or PNG?

**JPEG** files are smaller and fine for photos and slides. **PNG** keeps text and line drawings perfectly crisp, at a bigger size. If a site asks for “an image of your document”, JPEG is usually what it wants.

- **Originals are never changed.** Each result is a new file next to the original, with Undo.
- **Sandboxed and reviewed by Apple.** Sheaf is sold only on the Mac App Store and opens only the files you give it.
- **Ready for IT.** [Sheaf for Business](https://sheafai.app/business) deploys through Apple Business Manager with managed settings.

Only in this Mac's keychain. Sheaf has no servers and never uploads them.

Yes. Redact finds UK National Insurance numbers, US Social Security numbers and other national ID formats and deletes the text.

---
title: "Sheaf – Privacy Policy"
description: "Sheaf’s privacy policy: your files never leave your Mac. No account, no tracking, no data collected."
url: https://sheafai.app/privacy
---

# Privacy Policy

Short version: Sheaf doesn’t collect anything. Your files stay on your Mac.

Last updated November 3, 2026

## Your files

Everything Sheaf does (compressing, merging, splitting, converting, reading text with OCR, signing, redacting and password-protecting) happens on your Mac. Sheaf never uploads your files or their contents anywhere.

## No accounts, analytics or tracking

Sheaf has no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. The developer receives no information about you or how you use the app.

## What stays on your Mac

Sheaf keeps its settings, a saved signature (if you create one), which actions you use most (to order them), and simple counts such as how many files it has handled. These stay on your Mac and are deleted when you delete the app.

## Network use

Sheaf only uses the internet in two cases: Apple’s App Store handles the free trial and purchases (see [Apple’s Privacy Policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/)), and when you convert a web page file (HTML) to PDF, images or styles that page links to may be loaded so it looks right.

## Permissions

If you allow it, Sheaf uses your home folder only to save new files next to your originals and to watch folders you choose. It reads your Finder selection only when you press its shortcut. Notifications are only used for watched folders and trial reminders.

## Children

Sheaf doesn’t collect personal information from anyone, including children.

## Changes and contact

If this policy changes, this page will be updated. Questions? Email [singh.vikash2310@gmail.com](mailto:singh.vikash2310@gmail.com).


---
title: "How to Redact a PDF on Mac (Permanently Remove Text)"
description: "Permanently remove names, emails, phone, card and account numbers from a PDF on your Mac. Real redaction that deletes the text, not a black box."
url: https://sheafai.app/redact-pdf-mac
---

PDF tool for Mac

# Redact a PDF on Mac. Really redact it.

Drawing a black box over text is not redaction: the words underneath can still be copied. Real redaction deletes them from the file.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Free 7-day trial** · then one purchase, no subscription · macOS 14+

**In short:** To redact a PDF on a Mac, drag it, pause and choose Redact in Sheaf. It finds names, emails, phone, card, account and ID numbers, you review them, and the text under each mark is deleted from the new copy.Updated 13 November 2026

## Why black boxes fail

If you cover text with a shape in a PDF editor, the original text usually stays in the file. Anyone can select it, copy it, or delete the shape. This has leaked court filings and government documents more than once.

## What Sheaf finds

Names, email addresses, phone numbers, payment card numbers, bank account numbers and national ID formats (like US Social Security numbers, UK National Insurance numbers, Australian TFNs and others), including in scanned pages it reads with on-device text recognition. You can add your own words too.

Can I redact in Preview?

Preview has a Redact tool, but you mark each item yourself. Sheaf finds names, emails and numbers for you and removes the text underneath.

Can redacted text be recovered?

Not from a properly redacted file: the text is removed, not hidden. Keep the original somewhere safe if you need it later.

Does redaction work on scanned PDFs?

Yes. Sheaf reads scanned pages with on-device text recognition, so it can find and remove details in scans too.

Is it safe to redact PDFs online?

You would be uploading the very information you want to hide. Redact on your Mac instead.

## Is it legally binding?

## Three ways to split

- **Every page**: one PDF per page, numbered in order.
- **Page range**: type pages like 3–7 to pull exactly those into a new file.
- **By size**: parts that each fit your email limit (25 MB by default; change it in Settings).

## Splitting vs. compressing

If a file is just a little too big, [compress it](https://sheafai.app/compress-pdf-mac) first: one file is easier for the person receiving it. Split when the file is huge even after compressing, like a 300-page scanned archive, or when the receiver only needs some pages.

---
title: "Sheaf – Support"
description: "Help with Sheaf: how to use it, folder access, the free trial, restoring purchases and contact."
url: https://sheafai.app/support
---

# Support

Compress, merge, sign and convert PDFs on your Mac, right where you drag them. Everything runs on your Mac.

 **Need help?** Email [singh.vikash2310@gmail.com](mailto:singh.vikash2310@gmail.com?subject=Sheaf%20support). Tell us your macOS version and what you tried; we usually reply within a day or two.

## How do I use Sheaf?

Start dragging a PDF, image or document and pause for a moment. A circle of actions opens around the file. Move toward one (Compress, Merge, Convert…) and let go. The result appears right there, and every result can be undone. You can also click the Sheaf icon in the menu bar to choose files.

## Why are new files saved to Downloads?

Mac App Store apps can only open the files you give them. To save results next to your originals, open Sheaf Settings › Results › Folder access, click Allow… and choose your home folder. Sheaf never uploads your files.

## How does the free trial work?

Sheaf is free to download. Start the 7-day free trial to use everything, unlimited; no payment is needed. After the trial you keep 3 free actions a day. Sheaf Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks everything for good, with Family Sharing. There is no subscription.

## I bought Sheaf Pro. How do I restore it on another Mac?

Sign in with the same Apple Account, open Sheaf Settings and click Restore under Sheaf Pro.

## The Finder shortcut doesn’t work

The first time you press it (⌃⌥S by default), macOS asks whether Sheaf may read your Finder selection. If you declined, turn it on in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Automation › Sheaf › Finder.

## Refunds

Purchases are handled by Apple. You can request a refund at [reportaproblem.apple.com](https://reportaproblem.apple.com).


---
title: "Open a Password-Protected PDF on Mac (Statements, Payslips)"
description: "Open locked bank statements, payslips and tax PDFs on a Mac and save an unlocked copy. Password formats for India, the UK, the US and Singapore."
url: https://sheafai.app/unlock-password-protected-pdf-mac
---

# How to open a password-protected PDF on a Mac

Banks, payroll systems and tax offices lock PDFs with passwords made from your personal details. Here's how to open them quickly, and how to stop typing the same password every month.

**In short:** To open a password-protected PDF on a Mac, double-click it and type the password in Preview. To save a copy without the password, or to open many statements at once, drag them onto Sheaf and choose Unlock: Sheaf builds the password from details you saved, such as a PAN or National Insurance number and date of birth, and saves unlocked copies. It only opens files you can supply the details for; it does not crack passwords.

Updated 9 November 2026

## With Sheaf

1. Start dragging the locked PDFs, pause and choose Unlock.
2. Add the client: name, ID number, date of birth, customer IDs and mobile number, whatever you know.
3. Sheaf tries the patterns banks, payroll systems and tax offices use, and shows whose details opened each file.
4. Choose Save Unlocked Copy. The copy opens without a password; the original stays locked.

## Common password formats

| Document | Usual password | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| India: AIS (Income Tax) | PAN in lowercase + date of birth DDMMYYYY | abcde1234f05041990 |
| India: Form 26AS | Date of birth DDMMYYYY | 05041990 |
| India: many bank statements | First 4 letters of the name + DDMM, or customer ID | rame0504 |
| UK payslips (varies by payroll software) | Last 4 characters of the NI number, initials + DDMMYY, or surname + NI | 456C, JS050490 |
| Singapore | Last 4 of NRIC + DDMMYY, or DDMonYYYY + last 4 | 234A010183 |
| US documents | Often a date of birth MMDDYYYY or the last 4 of the SSN | 07041985 |

Formats change; the email that delivered your document usually says which one applies.

## With Preview

1. Open the PDF and enter the password.
2. Choose File › Export as PDF. Preview may keep the password, so check the copy.

[Download for Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Free 7-day trial · then one purchase, no subscription

## Questions

### Can Sheaf open a PDF without the password?

No. Sheaf only tries passwords made from details you enter and passwords you've saved. It does not break PDF encryption.

### Where are the saved details kept?

In this Mac's keychain, never uploaded or synced.

### What is the password for an AIS PDF?

Your PAN in lowercase followed by your date of birth as DDMMYYYY, for example abcde1234f05041990.

Your options on a Mac

## Three ways to do it, honestly compared.

### Word or Pages

Open the file, then File › Export / Save as PDF.

- Exact layout from the app itself
- One file at a time
- Needs the app installed

### Online PDF sites

Upload the file to a website, wait, download the result.

- Your document goes to someone else’s server
- Free plans limit files, size or tasks per day
- Needs an internet connection

Drag the file, pause, let go.

- Many documents at once
- .docx, .doc, .rtf, .odt, .txt, .md, .html

## Which files work

Word (.docx and .doc), RTF, OpenDocument text (.odt), plain text, Markdown and web pages (.html, .webarchive). Sheaf uses the page size and margins saved in the file, and keeps lists, tables and images in place.

Pages, Keynote and Numbers files aren’t converted by the Mac App Store version; export those from the app itself.

## When to use the app instead

For a document with a complicated design (custom fonts not on your Mac, text boxes, columns), exporting from Word or Pages gives the exact look. Sheaf is the fast way for everyday documents, and for many at once.

Drag the .docx onto Sheaf and choose Convert to PDF. TextEdit can also open many Word files and print them to PDF.

Can I convert several Word files to PDF at once?

Yes. Select them all in Finder, drag, and choose Convert to PDF. Each gets its own PDF.

Does it work with Pages files?

Not in the Mac App Store version. In Pages, use File › Export To › PDF.

使い方

## 3つの動作で、約1秒。

ポインタを一瞬止めると、周りにアクションが円形に開きます。

3. **離す**

アクションの上で離します。結果は元のファイルの横に表示され、取り消しもできます。

Sheafでできること

## 本当によくあるPDF作業を、すぐに。

[**PDFを圧縮**

スキャンやスライドを軽く、文字はくっきり。
](https://sheafai.app/ja/pdf-asshuku-mac)[**PDFを結合**

PDFと画像を1つに。ファイルごとにしおり付き。
](https://sheafai.app/ja/pdf-ketsugo-mac)[**PDFに署名**

署名は一度描けば、どのページにも配置。
](https://sheafai.app/ja/pdf-shomei-mac)
**墨消し**

氏名や口座番号を、隠すのではなく本当に削除。

**変換**

WordをPDFに、PDFをWord・JPEG・PNGに。

**OCR**

スキャンしたPDFを検索可能に。

## ファイルはMacから出ません。

オンラインのPDFサービスは、契約書や身分証、明細書を自社サーバーにアップロードします。SheafはすべてMac上で処理します。アップロードなし、アカウントなし、トラッキングなし。Wi-Fiを切っても動きます。

## 7日間無料。その後はずっとあなたのもの。

試用期間中はすべて無制限。その後も1日3回まで無料で使えます。すべての機能は1回の購入で解除でき、サブスクリプションはありません。ファミリー共有対応。

アプリは日本語に対応しています。

## 세 동작, 약 1초.

2. **잠시 멈춤**

포인터를 잠시 멈추면 주변에 동작이 원형으로 열립니다.

3. **놓기**

동작 위에서 놓으세요. 결과가 원본 옆에 나타나며 실행 취소도 됩니다.

PDF-Werkzeug für Mac

# PDF komprimieren auf dem Mac, in einer Sekunde.

E-Mail-Anhänge sind oft auf 20–25 MB begrenzt, und gescannte PDFs sind schnell größer. So verkleinerst du jedes PDF direkt am Mac, ohne es auf eine Website zu laden.

[Für Mac laden](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**7 Tage kostenlos** · danach einmal kaufen, kein Abo · macOS 14+

**Kurz gesagt:** Um ein PDF am Mac zu komprimieren, zieh es, warte kurz und wähle in Sheaf „Komprimieren“: Die kleinere Kopie erscheint neben dem Original, der Text bleibt scharf. Der Filter „Dateigröße reduzieren“ in Vorschau geht auch, macht Text aber oft unscharf.Aktualisiert am 13. November 2026

**Bleibt auf deinem Mac**Kein Upload, auch offline

**Kein Konto**Keine Anmeldung

**Original bleibt**Jedes Ergebnis ist eine neue Datei

**Einmal kaufen**Kein Abo

So geht’s

## Drei Handgriffe. Etwa eine Sekunde.

Keine App öffnen, kein Fenster suchen. Es passiert genau dort, wo die Datei schon ist.

1. **Ziehen**

Zieh die Datei aus dem Finder, aus Mail oder vom Schreibtisch.

2. **Kurz warten**

Halt einen Moment still: Die Aktionen öffnen sich im Kreis um den Zeiger.

3. **Auf „Komprimieren“ loslassen**

Die kleinere Kopie erscheint neben dem Original, mit dem Ergebnis, z. B. „42,7 MB → 3,3 MB“.

Deine Möglichkeiten am Mac

## Drei Wege, ehrlich verglichen.

### Vorschau (integriert)

Ablage › Exportieren, Quartz-Filter „Dateigröße reduzieren“.

- Kostenlos und schon auf dem Mac
- Nur eine Einstellung; Text wird oft unscharf
- Macht kleine Dateien manchmal größer

### Online-PDF-Seiten

Hochladen, warten, herunterladen.

- Dein Dokument landet auf einem fremden Server
- Gratis-Pläne begrenzen Dateien oder Größe
- Braucht Internet

### SheafAm schnellsten

Datei ziehen, kurz warten, loslassen.

- Etwa eine Sekunde, auch bei großen Scans
- Text bleibt scharf, Bilder schrumpfen am stärksten
- Zielgrößen für E-Mail und Upload-Formulare

## Was ein PDF groß macht

Fast immer Bilder: gescannte Seiten, Fotos und Folienhintergründe in voller Auflösung. Ein guter Kompressor verkleinert die Bilder und lässt den Text in Ruhe – die Datei wird kleiner, die Schrift bleibt scharf.

## Warum nicht online?

Online-Kompressoren funktionieren, aber deine Datei landet auf einem fremden Server. Für Verträge, Steuerunterlagen, Ausweise und Kontoauszüge ist das ein schlechter Tausch. Sheaf lädt nichts hoch.

Die App ist vollständig auf Deutsch.

## Fragen

Verliert ein komprimiertes PDF an Qualität?

Etwas, vor allem bei Bildern. Sheaf verkleinert Scans und Fotos und lässt Text als scharfen Vektortext.

Wie komprimiere ich ein PDF am Mac kostenlos?

In Vorschau: Ablage › Exportieren und Quartz-Filter „Dateigröße reduzieren“. Sheaf ist 7 Tage kostenlos, danach bleiben 3 Aktionen pro Tag gratis.

Ist es sicher, PDFs online zu komprimieren?

Online-Dienste laden dein Dokument auf ihre Server. Für private Dokumente nimm eine App, die auf dem Mac arbeitet.

Herramienta PDF para Mac

# Comprimir un PDF en Mac, en un segundo.

Los adjuntos suelen limitarse a 20–25 MB y un PDF escaneado los supera enseguida. Así reduces cualquier PDF en tu Mac sin subirlo a ninguna web.

[Descargar para Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Prueba gratis de 7 días** · después una sola compra, sin suscripción · macOS 14+

**En resumen:** Para comprimir un PDF en Mac, arrástralo, haz una pausa y elige Comprimir en Sheaf: la copia más ligera aparece junto al original, con el texto nítido. El filtro «Reducir tamaño de archivo» de Vista Previa también sirve, pero a menudo emborrona el texto.Actualizado el 13 de noviembre de 2026

**Se queda en tu Mac**Sin subir nada, funciona sin conexión

**Sin cuenta**Nada que registrar

**Originales intactos**Cada resultado es un archivo nuevo

**Pago único**Sin suscripción

Cómo funciona

## Tres gestos. Un segundo, más o menos.

Sin abrir apps ni buscar ventanas. Ocurre donde ya está el archivo.

1. **Arrastra**

Empieza a arrastrar el archivo desde el Finder, Mail o el escritorio.

2. **Haz una pausa**

Quédate quieto un momento: las acciones se abren en círculo alrededor del puntero.

3. **Suelta sobre Comprimir**

La copia más ligera aparece junto al original, con el resultado, p. ej. «42,7 MB → 3,3 MB».

Tus opciones en Mac

## Tres formas, comparadas con honestidad.

### Vista Previa (incluida)

Archivo › Exportar, filtro Quartz «Reducir tamaño de archivo».

- Gratis y ya en tu Mac
- Un solo ajuste; el texto suele quedar borroso
- A veces agranda archivos pequeños

### Webs de PDF en línea

Subir, esperar, descargar.

- Tu documento va al servidor de otra empresa
- Los planes gratis limitan archivos o tamaño
- Necesita internet

### SheafEl más rápido

Arrastra el archivo, pausa, suelta.

- Un segundo, incluso con escaneos grandes
- Texto nítido; las imágenes se reducen más
- Tamaños objetivo para correo y formularios

## Qué hace pesado un PDF

Casi siempre las imágenes: páginas escaneadas, fotos y fondos de diapositivas a resolución completa. Un buen compresor reduce las imágenes y deja el texto intacto.

## ¿Por qué no en línea?

Los compresores en línea funcionan, pero tu archivo va al servidor de otra empresa. Para contratos, declaraciones, documentos de identidad o extractos, no compensa. Sheaf no sube nada.

La app está totalmente en español.

## Preguntas

¿Comprimir un PDF reduce la calidad?

Algo, sobre todo en las imágenes. Sheaf reduce escaneos y fotos y mantiene el texto como texto vectorial nítido.

¿Cómo comprimo un PDF gratis en Mac?

En Vista Previa: Archivo › Exportar, filtro Quartz «Reducir tamaño de archivo». Sheaf es gratis 7 días y después 3 acciones al día siguen gratis.

¿Es seguro comprimir PDF en línea?

Los servicios en línea suben tu documento a sus servidores. Para documentos privados, usa una app que trabaje en tu Mac.

## Tu próximo PDF tarda un segundo.

Outil PDF pour Mac

# Compresser un PDF sur Mac, en une seconde.

Les pièces jointes sont souvent limitées à 20–25 Mo, et un PDF scanné dépasse vite. Voici comment réduire n’importe quel PDF sur votre Mac sans l’envoyer sur un site.

[Télécharger pour Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Essai gratuit de 7 jours** · puis un seul achat, sans abonnement · macOS 14+

**En bref :** Pour compresser un PDF sur Mac, faites-le glisser, marquez une pause et choisissez Compresser dans Sheaf : la copie allégée apparaît à côté de l’original, le texte reste net. Le filtre « Réduire la taille du fichier » d’Aperçu marche aussi, mais rend souvent le texte flou.Mis à jour le 13 novembre 2026

**Reste sur votre Mac**Aucun envoi, fonctionne hors ligne

**Aucun compte**Rien à créer

**Originaux intacts**Chaque résultat est un nouveau fichier

**Achat unique**Sans abonnement

Comment ça marche

## Trois gestes. Environ une seconde.

Aucune app à ouvrir, aucune fenêtre à chercher. Tout se passe là où se trouve le fichier.

1. **Glissez**

Commencez à faire glisser le fichier depuis le Finder, Mail ou le bureau.

2. **Marquez une pause**

Restez immobile un instant : les actions s’ouvrent en cercle autour du pointeur.

3. **Relâchez sur Compresser**

La copie allégée apparaît à côté de l’original, avec le résultat, par ex. « 42,7 Mo → 3,3 Mo ».

Vos options sur Mac

## Trois méthodes, comparées honnêtement.

### Aperçu (intégré)

Fichier › Exporter, filtre Quartz « Réduire la taille du fichier ».

- Gratuit et déjà sur votre Mac
- Un seul réglage ; texte souvent flou
- Grossit parfois les petits fichiers

### Sites PDF en ligne

Envoyer, attendre, télécharger.

- Votre document part sur le serveur d’un tiers
- Les offres gratuites limitent fichiers ou taille
- Connexion Internet nécessaire

### SheafLe plus rapide

Glissez le fichier, pause, relâchez.

- Une seconde environ, même pour de gros scans
- Texte net, les images rétrécissent le plus
- Tailles cibles pour l’e-mail et les formulaires

## Ce qui rend un PDF lourd

Presque toujours les images : pages scannées, photos et fonds de diapositives en pleine résolution. Un bon compresseur réduit les images et laisse le texte intact.

## Pourquoi pas en ligne ?

Les compresseurs en ligne fonctionnent, mais votre fichier part sur le serveur d’un tiers. Pour des contrats, avis d’imposition, pièces d’identité ou relevés, c’est un mauvais échange. Sheaf n’envoie rien.

L’app est entièrement en français.

## Questions

La compression réduit-elle la qualité ?

Un peu, surtout sur les images. Sheaf réduit scans et photos et garde le texte en texte vectoriel net.

Comment compresser un PDF gratuitement sur Mac ?

Dans Aperçu : Fichier › Exporter, filtre Quartz « Réduire la taille du fichier ». Sheaf est gratuit 7 jours, puis 3 actions par jour restent gratuites.

Est-il sûr de compresser un PDF en ligne ?

Les services en ligne envoient votre document sur leurs serveurs. Pour des documents privés, utilisez une app qui travaille sur votre Mac.

Strumento PDF per Mac

# Comprimere un PDF su Mac, in un secondo.

Gli allegati email sono spesso limitati a 20–25 MB e un PDF scansionato li supera in fretta. Ecco come ridurre qualsiasi PDF sul Mac senza caricarlo su un sito.

[Scarica per Mac](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**Prova gratuita di 7 giorni** · poi un solo acquisto, nessun abbonamento · macOS 14+

**In breve:** Per comprimere un PDF su Mac, trascinalo, fermati un attimo e scegli Comprimi in Sheaf: la copia più leggera compare accanto all’originale, con il testo nitido. Anche il filtro «Riduci dimensioni file» di Anteprima funziona, ma spesso sfoca il testo.Aggiornato il 13 novembre 2026

**Resta sul tuo Mac**Nessun caricamento, funziona offline

**Nessun account**Niente registrazione

**Originali intatti**Ogni risultato è un nuovo file

**Acquisto unico**Nessun abbonamento

Come funziona

## Tre gesti. Circa un secondo.

Nessuna app da aprire, nessuna finestra da cercare. Succede dove si trova già il file.

1. **Trascina**

Inizia a trascinare il file dal Finder, da Mail o dalla scrivania.

2. **Fermati**

Resta fermo un istante: le azioni si aprono in cerchio intorno al puntatore.

3. **Rilascia su Comprimi**

La copia più leggera compare accanto all’originale, con il risultato, es. «42,7 MB → 3,3 MB».

Le tue opzioni su Mac

## Tre modi, confrontati onestamente.

### Anteprima (inclusa)

File › Esporta, filtro Quartz «Riduci dimensioni file».

- Gratis e già sul Mac
- Una sola impostazione; testo spesso sfocato
- A volte ingrandisce i file piccoli

### Siti PDF online

Carica, aspetta, scarica.

- Il documento finisce sul server di altri
- I piani gratuiti limitano file o dimensioni
- Serve internet

### SheafIl più veloce

Trascina il file, fermati, rilascia.

- Circa un secondo, anche con scansioni grandi
- Testo nitido; le immagini si riducono di più
- Dimensioni obiettivo per email e moduli

## Cosa rende pesante un PDF

Quasi sempre le immagini: pagine scansionate, foto e sfondi delle slide a piena risoluzione. Un buon compressore riduce le immagini e lascia intatto il testo.

## Perché non online?

I compressori online funzionano, ma il file finisce sul server di altri. Per contratti, dichiarazioni, documenti d’identità ed estratti conto non conviene. Sheaf non carica nulla.

Per ora l’app è in inglese; funziona con documenti in qualsiasi lingua.

## Domande

Comprimere un PDF riduce la qualità?

Un po’, soprattutto nelle immagini. Sheaf riduce scansioni e foto e mantiene il testo nitido.

Come comprimo un PDF gratis su Mac?

In Anteprima: File › Esporta, filtro Quartz «Riduci dimensioni file». Sheaf è gratis 7 giorni, poi 3 azioni al giorno restano gratuite.

È sicuro comprimere PDF online?

I servizi online caricano il documento sui loro server. Per documenti privati usa un’app che lavora sul Mac.

title: "MacでPDFを圧縮する方法 – アップロード不要、約1秒"
description: "MacでPDFのファイルサイズを約1秒で小さく。文字はくっきり。プレビュー、オンラインサイト、Sheafを比較。オフラインで動作。"
url: https://sheafai.app/ja/pdf-asshuku-mac
---

Mac用PDFツール

# MacでPDFを圧縮、約1秒で。

メールの添付は20〜25MB程度が上限のことが多く、スキャンしたPDFはすぐに超えてしまいます。Webサイトに送らず、Mac上でPDFを小さくする方法です。

[Mac版をダウンロード](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**7日間無料** · その後は買い切り、サブスクなし · macOS 14以降

**要点：** MacでPDFを圧縮するには、PDFをドラッグして少し待ち、Sheafで「圧縮」を選びます。小さくなったコピーが元のファイルの横に作られ、文字はくっきりしたままです。プレビューのQuartzフィルタ「ファイルサイズを小さくする」も使えますが、文字がぼやけがちです。更新日 2026年11月13日

**Macの中で完結**アップロードなし、オフラインで動作

**アカウント不要**登録は一切なし

**元のファイルはそのまま**結果は常に新しいファイル

**買い切り**サブスクなし

使い方

## 3つの動作で、約1秒。

アプリを開く必要も、ウインドウを探す必要もありません。ファイルがある場所で完了します。

1. **ドラッグ**

Finder、メール、デスクトップからファイルをドラッグし始めます。

2. **少し待つ**

ポインタを一瞬止めると、周りにアクションが円形に開きます。

3. **「圧縮」で離す**

小さくなったコピーが元のファイルの横に表示されます（例：42.7 MB → 3.3 MB）。

Macでの方法

## 3つの方法を正直に比較。

### プレビュー（標準搭載）

ファイル › 書き出す、Quartzフィルタ「ファイルサイズを小さくする」。

- 無料でMacに最初から入っている
- 設定は1つだけ。文字がぼやけやすい
- 小さいファイルが逆に大きくなることも

### オンラインPDFサイト

アップロードして、待って、ダウンロード。

- 書類が他社のサーバーに送られる
- 無料プランはファイル数やサイズに制限
- インターネットが必要

### Sheaf最速

ファイルをドラッグ、少し待って、離す。

- 大きなスキャンでも約1秒
- 文字はくっきり、画像を中心に圧縮
- メールやフォーム向けの目標サイズ

## PDFが大きくなる原因

ほとんどの場合は画像です。スキャンしたページ、写真、スライドの背景がフル解像度で保存されています。良い圧縮ツールは画像を小さくし、文字には手を加えません。

## オンラインではだめ？

オンラインの圧縮サービスも使えますが、ファイルは他社のサーバーに送られます。契約書、税務書類、身分証、明細書には向きません。Sheafは何もアップロードしません。

アプリは日本語に対応しています。

## よくある質問

圧縮すると画質は落ちますか？

主に画像が多少落ちます。Sheafはスキャンや写真を小さくし、文字はくっきりしたベクターのまま残します。

MacでPDFを無料で圧縮するには？

プレビューで「ファイル › 書き出す」を選び、Quartzフィルタ「ファイルサイズを小さくする」を指定します。Sheafは7日間無料、その後も1日3回まで無料です。

オンラインでPDFを圧縮しても安全？

オンラインサービスは書類をサーバーにアップロードします。個人的な書類にはMac上で動くアプリを使いましょう。

## 次のPDFは1秒で終わります。

ドラッグして、少し待って、離すだけ。7日間無料、その後は1回の購入でずっと使えます。ファミリー共有対応。
[Mac版をダウンロード](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Mac App Store · macOS 14以降 · Appleシリコン/Intel

title: "MacでPDFを結合する方法 – 数秒で、オフラインで"

url: https://sheafai.app/ja/pdf-ketsugo-mac

# MacでPDFを結合、選んだ順番で。

ポインタを一瞬止めると、周りにアクションが円形に開きます。

3. **「結合」で離す**

選んだ順番で、しおり付きの新しいPDFができます。

Macでの方法

## 3つの方法を正直に比較。

### プレビュー（標準搭載）

サムネールを表示し、他のPDFをドラッグして、PDFとして書き出す。

- 無料で標準搭載
- 違う場所にドロップしやすい
- 元のファイルを変更してしまうことも

### オンラインPDFサイト

アップロードして、待って、ダウンロード。

- 書類が他社のサーバーに送られる
- 無料プランはファイル数やサイズに制限
- インターネットが必要

### Sheaf最速

ファイルをドラッグ、少し待って、離す。

- PDFと画像を一度に
- 元のファイルごとにしおり
- 元のファイルはそのまま、取り消し可能

## PDFと画像をまとめて

SheafはPDFと画像（JPEG、PNG、HEIC）を同時に受け付けます。スキャンした書類、領収書の写真、契約書を1つのPDFにできます。

## 順番を決める

選択した順番で結合されます。ページの移動・回転・削除をしたいときは「整理」を選び、きれいな1ファイルとして保存します。

アプリは日本語に対応しています。

## よくある質問

PDFとJPGを結合できますか？

はい。SheafはPDFと画像を同時に受け付け、1つのPDFにします。

MacでPDFを無料で結合するには？

プレビューで最初のPDFを開き、サムネールを表示して他のPDFをサイドバーにドラッグし、PDFとして書き出します。

元のファイルは残りますか？

はい。Sheafは新しいファイルを作り、元のファイルには手を加えません。

## 次のPDFは1秒で終わります。

ドラッグして、少し待って、離すだけ。7日間無料、その後は1回の購入でずっと使えます。ファミリー共有対応。
[Mac版をダウンロード](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Mac App Store · macOS 14以降 · Appleシリコン/Intel

Mac用PDFツール

# MacでPDFに署名、プリンタなしで。

賃貸契約、見積書、各種書類。署名は一度描けば、必要な場所にぴったり置けます。

[Mac版をダウンロード](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**7日間無料** · その後は買い切り、サブスクなし · macOS 14以降

**要点：** MacでPDFに署名するには、PDFをドラッグして少し待ち、Sheafで「署名」を選んで、保存した署名をページにドラッグします。署名はMacの中だけに保存され、署名済みの新しいコピーが作られます。更新日 2026年11月13日

**Macの中で完結**アップロードなし、オフラインで動作

**アカウント不要**登録は一切なし

**元のファイルはそのまま**結果は常に新しいファイル

**買い切り**サブスクなし

使い方

## 3つの動作で、約1秒。

アプリを開く必要も、ウインドウを探す必要もありません。ファイルがある場所で完了します。

1. **ドラッグ**

Finder、メール、デスクトップからファイルをドラッグし始めます。

2. **少し待つ**

ポインタを一瞬止めると、周りにアクションが円形に開きます。

3. **「署名」で離す**

署名を必要な場所へ。最初・最後・すべてのページに配置できます。

Macでの方法

## 3つの方法を正直に比較。

### プレビュー（標準搭載）

マークアップ › 署名 で配置。

- 無料で標準搭載
- カメラでも署名を取り込める
- 一度に1つの書類だけ

### オンラインPDFサイト

アップロードして、待って、ダウンロード。

- 書類が他社のサーバーに送られる
- 無料プランはファイル数やサイズに制限
- インターネットが必要

### Sheaf最速

ファイルをドラッグ、少し待って、離す。

- 署名はMacの中だけ
- 最初・最後・すべてのページ
- 複数のPDFの同じ位置に

## 一度描けば、何度でも

最初にトラックパッドやマウスで署名を描きます。Sheafはこのマック上にだけ保存し、アップロードはしません。

## 法的に有効？

多くの国で、日常的な契約には簡易な電子署名で十分です。特別な書類では相手が何を求めているか確認してください。

アプリは日本語に対応しています。

## よくある質問

署名はどこに保存されますか？

Sheafでは、あなたのMacの中だけです。アップロードされることはありません。

AdobeなしでPDFに署名できますか？

はい。プレビューとSheafなら、Adobe Acrobatもアカウントもなしで署名できます。

複数のPDFにまとめて署名できますか？

はい。まとめてドラッグして「署名」を選ぶと、それぞれの同じ位置に署名されます。

## 次のPDFは1秒で終わります。

ドラッグして、少し待って、離すだけ。7日間無料、その後は1回の購入でずっと使えます。ファミリー共有対応。
[Mac版をダウンロード](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Mac용 PDF 도구

# Mac에서 PDF 압축, 약 1초면 끝.

이메일 첨부는 보통 20–25MB로 제한되고, 스캔한 PDF는 금방 넘어갑니다. 웹사이트에 올리지 않고 Mac에서 PDF를 줄이는 방법입니다.

[Mac용 다운로드](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**7일 무료 체험** · 이후 한 번 구매, 구독 없음 · macOS 14+

**요약:** Mac에서 PDF를 압축하려면 PDF를 드래그하고 잠시 멈춘 뒤 Sheaf에서 '압축'을 고르세요. 더 작은 사본이 원본 옆에 생기고 글자는 선명하게 유지됩니다. 미리보기의 Quartz 필터 '파일 크기 축소'도 되지만 글자가 흐려지기 쉽습니다.업데이트 2026년 11월 13일

**Mac 안에서 처리**업로드 없음, 오프라인 작동

**계정 불필요**가입할 필요 없음

**원본 그대로**결과는 항상 새 파일

**한 번 구매**구독 없음

사용 방법

## 세 동작, 약 1초.

앱을 열 필요도, 창을 찾을 필요도 없습니다. 파일이 있는 바로 그 자리에서 끝납니다.

1. **드래그**

Finder, 메일 또는 데스크탑에서 파일을 드래그하기 시작합니다.

2. **잠시 멈춤**

포인터를 잠시 멈추면 주변에 동작이 원형으로 열립니다.

3. **'압축'에서 놓기**

더 작은 사본이 원본 옆에 결과와 함께 나타납니다(예: 42.7MB → 3.3MB).

Mac에서의 방법

## 세 가지 방법, 솔직하게 비교.

### 미리보기(기본 제공)

파일 › 내보내기, Quartz 필터 '파일 크기 축소'.

- 무료, 기본 제공
- 설정이 하나뿐이고 글자가 흐려지기 쉬움
- 작은 파일이 오히려 커지기도 함

### 온라인 PDF 사이트

업로드하고, 기다리고, 다운로드.

- 문서가 다른 회사 서버로 전송됨
- 무료 요금제는 파일 수나 크기 제한
- 인터넷 필요

### Sheaf가장 빠름

파일을 드래그하고, 멈추고, 놓기.

- 큰 스캔본도 약 1초
- 글자는 선명, 이미지 위주로 압축
- 이메일·양식용 목표 크기

## PDF가 큰 이유

거의 항상 이미지 때문입니다. 스캔한 페이지, 사진, 슬라이드 배경이 원본 해상도로 저장되어 있습니다. 좋은 압축 도구는 이미지를 줄이고 글자는 그대로 둡니다.

## 왜 온라인이 아닌가요?

온라인 압축도 되지만 파일이 다른 회사 서버로 갑니다. 계약서, 세금 서류, 신분증, 은행 명세서에는 맞지 않습니다. Sheaf는 아무것도 업로드하지 않습니다.

앱은 현재 영어로 제공되며, 모든 언어의 문서를 처리할 수 있습니다.

## 자주 묻는 질문

압축하면 화질이 떨어지나요?

주로 이미지가 조금 떨어집니다. Sheaf는 스캔본과 사진을 줄이고 글자는 선명한 벡터 텍스트로 유지합니다.

Mac에서 PDF를 무료로 압축하려면?

미리보기에서 파일 › 내보내기를 고르고 Quartz 필터 '파일 크기 축소'를 선택하세요. Sheaf는 7일 무료이며 이후에도 하루 3회 무료입니다.

온라인에서 PDF를 압축해도 안전한가요?

온라인 서비스는 문서를 자사 서버에 업로드합니다. 개인 문서에는 Mac에서 처리하는 앱을 쓰세요.

## 다음 PDF는 1초면 끝납니다.

드래그하고, 잠시 멈추고, 놓으세요. 7일 무료, 이후 한 번 구매로 계속 사용. 가족 공유 지원.
[Mac용 다운로드](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

Mac App Store · macOS 14 이상 · Apple 실리콘 및 Intel

# Mac에서 PDF 합치기, 고른 순서대로.

영수증, 스캔본, 계약서, 사진을 깔끔한 PDF 하나로. Finder에서 골라 드래그하면 미리보기 메뉴를 찾기 전에 끝납니다.

[Mac용 다운로드](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830258390)

**7일 무료 체험** · 이후 한 번 구매, 구독 없음 · macOS 14+

**요약:** Mac에서 PDF를 합치려면 Finder에서 파일을 골라 드래그하고, 잠시 멈춘 뒤 Sheaf에서 '합치기'를 고르세요. 파일마다 책갈피가 달린 새 PDF가 생기고 원본은 바뀌지 않습니다.업데이트 2026년 11월 13일

**Mac 안에서 처리**업로드 없음, 오프라인 작동
